system.description:
Deal 5 direct damage to the target. This skill's [Hate] cost is equal to [Number of Targets + 1]. 

(Target: Mob & Post-Action): The target becomes [Incapacitated] or [Dead] (your choice).

(Target: Mob & Pre-Action): The target becomes [Post-Action].

A special skill that consumes the target's soul by playing a melody with feelings of blockage and restraint. Those who do not have a firm will will find it difficult to move under the resounding elegy.
